proof_summary: Expand the two zeta values as Dirichlet series, split off the terms with denominators at most 10, and bound both remaining tails by $O(11^{-n})$. An exact polynomial cancellation after subtracting the four displayed terms leaves only monomials whose combined bases are at least 11, while the quotient denominator tends to $2$, so the resulting error remains $O(11^{-n})$.
